questions.question: Is there any chart feature or public-task evidence that establishes whether the parenthetical slice inscriptions, rather than the visibly conflicting pie-slice angular areas, are authoritative for the current market-share values?

summary: Inspected the pie’s title, all four in-slice inscriptions, their visible attachment to slices, the conflicting slice-area ordering, and the public highest-current-market-share rule and Apple option. The existing set covers the label-based Apple reading and the geometry-based support limitation; the remaining bounded issue is the unresolved authority between those encodings.
